EA Games
EA Games Club is a WAP based portal for all smart phones running on both Java and Android. You can subscribe to the service via both SMS and WAP. You can also avail this service on demand basis.
Subscription through SMS
To subscribe the service through SMS type
“STARTEA”
and send to
25656
.
In reply SMS, you will receive the service URL:
ea.b2mwap.com
from where yo
u

ea.b2mwap.com
and subscribe using the subscription button.
